desktop.title: Desktop pet
desktop.hint: These buttons run zeron-pet as you, on this device (Linux/Wayland helper). If it isn't installed, the packaged companion's install.sh puts zeron-pet on your PATH — building alone (cargo build / ./run.sh) does not. The pet is a separate program: it keeps running if this plugin is turned off, and its own --status output is the truth.
